close_reason: run_cert_at_issuance() added; audit vs operational modes documented in run_cert; 2 new tests
description:
Operators have two distinct use cases:
- Audit mode: 'was this cert compliant when it was issued?' (pass issuance time as now_unix)
- Operational mode: 'is this cert compliant under current rules?' (pass current time as now_unix)

The API already supports this via now_unix parameter in check_cert. What is missing:
1. Explicit documentation explaining both modes and how to select them
2. A named constant or helper: LintRunner::run_cert_at_issuance(cert, kind, issued_at) that extracts notBefore from the cert and uses it as now_unix
3. Lint authors must document whether their lint is issuance-time sensitive (SC-081 validity caps) or evaluation-time sensitive (algorithm retirement)
4. Consider adding a LintMode enum { Issuance, Operational } to make the intent explicit in the LintRunner call signature
title: pkix-lint: time-of-issuance vs time-of-evaluation mode — API and docs
